item.tib: bcud dril bkra shis gter rdzong gi rgyud las zhi ba rin chen spungs pa'i gzhung
item.coloph: de nas mkha' 'gro thugs rje byams ma yis/ lung bstan gdams pa 'di gnang bas/ skad cig mkha' spyod zhing der gshegs/ chu zla'i dkyil 'khor yal ba bzhin/ mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang la song / ma 'ong snyigs ma'i kho bo bdag/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang dam thub par byas/ de ste ma 'ong tha ma la/ gshen grogs dam ldan rnams kyi rkyen gyis bskul/ skal ldan 'gro la phan phyir yi ger btab/ nyes 'gal mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ bdag sogs mkha' khyab smin grol don rtogs nas/ 'chi med rig 'dzin drung du skye bar shog sa ma ya rgya/ mkha' 'gro mas kho bo byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyi snyan du brgyud pa'o/ me rta zla tshes gnas bya khri 'bar gyi g.yas zur du legs bkod mu tsug smar ro//
